selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state before disruption (sysctl values, boot identity)
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed accept_redirects/secure_redirects/accept_source_route were 0 for all/default/eth0 and captured boot_id 15443601-befc-4fc4-aa76-b417968ad3f9 plus config file presence before reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent disabling of ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance (IPv4)
selected_evidence.summary: Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf with accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 for all/default/eth0, applied via sysctl --system, and verified runtime values are 0

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returning before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Issued sudo -n systemctl reboot backgrounded with a short sleep; exec call returned success (pid reported) before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 15443601-befc-4fc4-aa76-b417968ad3f9 (pre-reboot) to 0ed92e28-013f-4393-9744-b650eab06ef1 (post-reboot), with an intermediate connection-timeout confirming the node was down mid-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required configuration and network health
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf still present, all target sysctl values still 0 for all/default/eth0, and eth0 network interface up with correct IP address

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: baseline current sysctl values =="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects \
  net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects \
  net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route

echo "== STEP 2: write persistent sysctl config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
EOF
cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf

echo "== STEP 3: apply immediately =="
sudo -n sysctl --system

echo "== STEP 4: verify runtime values =="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects \
  net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects \
  net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route

echo "== DONE =="
